messages:
mike: Quick ping — PR #4321 ready for security review. Changes: auth token rotation logic, secret fetch path for private deploys, and a tiny VPC egress rule. Would appreciate a quick check before I merge today.

jess: tagging the PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321

sara: thanks @mike — I'll take a look. Is this touching any KMS/HSM configs or just the app secret path?

mike: mainly the secret path + a new env var REDWOOD_VPC_SECRET_PATH. We still use customer KMS; no HSM changes. Also added a fallback that fetches from metadata for dedicated nodes.

sara: ok. two quick asks: (1) show how REDWOOD_VPC_SECRET_PATH is provisioned for private/on-prem (2) confirm least-priv IAM role for the metadata fetch. Can you paste the snippet?

jess: snippet from the PR:

```
# config snippet
REDWOOD_VPC_SECRET_PATH=/secrets/redwood/token
# fallback
if [ -z "$REDWOOD_VPC_SECRET_PATH" ]; then
  TOKEN=$(curl -sf http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/role-name)
fi
```

mike: the intent is: customers on Private set the path in Vault mounted to the node, Dedicated uses instance profile metadata fallback. We added a note to the deploy guide but can expand.

sara: that metadata call worries me — we need to ensure the IAM role only allows GetRoleCredentials for the named service principal, and there is a config flag to disable fallback in air-gapped installs.

mike: good call — there is DISABLE_METADATA_FALLBACK env var, default false. I'll flip to default true for Private builds and make the deploy guide clearer.

devsec-bot: Automated scan results for PR #4321 — static analysis: 0 high, 1 medium (use of metadata fallback without explicit role restrict). Please address.

sara: thanks @devsec-bot. @mike please add explicit IAM policy snippet and add a one-line doc note: "Disable metadata fallback in air-gapped/private installs".

jess: added IAM example in last commit (see PR comment). Policy restricts to sts:GetCallerIdentity on the service role and kms:Decrypt for the customer-managed key ARN.

sara: can you paste the policy line for kms?

jess: sure:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
}
```

sara: that looks fine. One more: secret values should never be logged. Any debug logs added?

mike: no secret logging. I added a mask for REDWOOD_VPC_SECRET_PATH in our logging util.

oliver: quick infra note — the VPC egress rule only opens 443 to customer vaults; we tightened CIDR to customer ranges, not 0.0.0.0/0.

sara: great. From security side: :thumbsup: LGTM after the doc update mentioning DISABLE_METADATA_FALLBACK default for Private and the IAM example. Can we get one SRE sign-off for the network rule?

oliver: I reviewed the egress rule. ok from infra side. Will add a short note in the infra change log.

mike: thanks @sara @oliver. I'll update the deploy guide and push one more commit. Target merge in ~2h after CI passes.

devsec-bot: CI: all checks passing except the dependency-scan which is queued.

jess: will re-run the dependency-scan once you update docs.

mike: done — pushed docs and set DISABLE_METADATA_FALLBACK default=true for Private images. Re-run CI now.

devsec-bot: dependency-scan: passed. All checks green.

sara: approving the PR here. No further security blockers.

mike: merging now. Thanks everyone :rocket:

jess: nice, will monitor canary for two deploy cycles.

oliver: noted, I'll watch network logs and alert if any unexpected egress appears.

mike: follow-up: I'll open a small doc PR to central ops guide describing the fallback toggle and IAM template.
